text:
Maria: Heads-up — vendor just messaged: partial cancellation of our eu-west rack for next-week demo window (ticket VW-2234). They say 4 A100 slots might be pulled. Need quick plan to avoid customer-facing regressions. :grimacing:
Akshay: Ugh. Which pools are those attached to? reserved/dedicated or demo staging?
Maria: Looks like 2 in `dedicated-demo-pool-eu` and 2 in `staging-interactive`. I can paste the vendor note in a sec.
Jordan: If we can drop non-critical nightly jobs from staging that's 2 slots freed instantly. Canary traffic is low tonight.
Lee: We have reserved commits on the dedicated side — moving those could trigger billing churn. Need finance signoff if we reassign.
Sasha: @Lee who in finance can we ping fast? Also we have an open Terraform PR that sets `pool_allocation` for demo -> might be a one-line change to move 2 slots.
Maria: vendor note: "due to supply shuffle, eu-west rack ETA delayed 7 days; standby slots may be available but on hold until next allocation."
VendorOps: VW-2234 updated — vendor offered temporary standby at a different colo (latency unknown). They asked if we want cross-colo swap. ETA 48-72h to confirm.
Akshay: Cross-colo swap ok for non-latency sensitive demos, but not for live customer sessions. We should prefer intra-region swap first.
Jordan: Agree. Can we scavenge 2 A100s from `canary-burst`? Those workloads can drop to smaller batch size for 6h.
Sasha: I can open the quick PR. Patch would be something like:
```hcl
resource "redwood_pool_allocation" "demo_shift" {
  pool = "staging-interactive"
  a100_slots = 0 # reduce by 2
}
```
Sasha: then increase `dedicated-demo-pool-eu` by 2.
Maria: If someone from infra can merge & apply, we can validate before vendor confirms. Need an ETA on terraform apply.
Lee: I'll check with finance now. If they flag cost, we'll fallback to borrow from `canary-burst`.
DeployBot: Canary alerts suppressed for tonight window (22:00-04:00 UTC) per @Jordan request.
Jordan: I'll scale down batch jobs at 21:30 UTC and post when done.
Akshay: Maria can you list the demo sessions scheduled so we can prioritize which ones must stay on eu-west?
Maria: Posted schedule in the workbook — top 3 must stay (enterprise demos). Others are flexible.
VendorOps: Update: vendor tentatively confirmed standby in eu-west2-colo for 6 slots, but routing needs manual peering, which adds ~30-60s RTT.
Sasha: For the flexible demos we can route to that colo. For enterprise demos we keep pinned to eu-west primary.
Lee: Finance says short-term reallocation is OK if we record the cost impact. Proceed but tag invoices.
Maria: Plan: 1) Jordan scales down batch (21:30 UTC) 2) Sasha opens PR to shift 2 slots from staging -> dedicated-demo 3) Akshay/Lee approve once finance tag added 4) If vendor standby confirmed, route flexible demos there.
Akshay: Will review PR asap.
Jordan: Batch scaled down and verified — freed ~2 A100s.
Sasha: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4892 — terraform plan looks clean.
Akshay: Approved the plan, leaving apply to infra oncall.
Maria: @oncall-infra can you apply the PR and monitor demo latency for the next 2 hours?
VendorOps: VW-2234 vendor confirmed standby, sending peering details.
Lee: Applied invoice tag. Finance notified.
InfraOncall (via VendorOps): Applied PR at 22:10 UTC. Pools adjusted. Early checks: demo routing stable, latency +15-20ms for flexible demos routed to standby colo.
Maria: Thanks all. I'll message sales to reschedule any high-priority demos if we see anomalies.
Jordan: No regression on internal smoke tests.
Sasha: Leaving a note in the infra runbook about this swap and the vendor ticket.
Maria: :thumbsup: Good work — keeping this thread for audit.
Akshay: Adding follow-up: we should test peering automation for standby colo next quarter to avoid manual swap.
Maria: Filed a follow-up ticket: INFRA-781.
Sasha: Closing loop — VW-2234 resolved as "standby allocated".
VendorOps: Closing internal vendor ticket, will reopen if allocation changes.
Maria: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if vendor updates.
